1-1.title: Cybersecurity Strategy
1-1.objective: To ensure that cybersecurity plans, goals, initiatives and projects are contributing to compliance with related laws and regulations.
1-1.full_text: 1-1 Cybersecurity Strategy: Objective is to ensure that cybersecurity plans, goals, initiatives and projects are contributing to compliance with related laws and regulations.

1-1-1.title: Strategy Definition and Approval
1-1-1.objective: To define, document, and approve a cybersecurity strategy supported by senior leadership.
implementation_guidelines: Conduct a workshop with stakeholders to align cybersecurity objectives with the organization's strategic objectives.
Develop and document the strategy to align with related laws and regulations (e.g., CCC, CSCC).
The strategy must include: Vision, Mission, Strategic Objectives, Strategy Implementation Plan, Projects, and Initiatives.
Obtain approval from the head of the organization or an Authorizing Official based on the approved authority matrix.
expected_deliverables: Approved cybersecurity strategy document (electronic or official hard copy).
List of initiatives and projects included in the strategy.
cybersecurity_tools: All cybersecurity strategy models and roadmap
1-1-1.full_text: 1-1 Cybersecurity Strategy — 1-1-1 A cybersecurity strategy must be defined, documented and approved. It must be supported by the head of the organization or his/her delegate (Authorizing Official). The strategy goals must be in-line with related laws and regulations.

1-1-2.title: Strategy Implementation Roadmap
1-1-2.objective: To execute a roadmap for implementing the cybersecurity strategy.
implementation_guidelines: Develop a roadmap for implementing the strategy including the execution of initiatives and projects.
Define cybersecurity priorities and make recommendations consistent with the nature of work.
Monitor the implementation of strategy projects and take corrective steps if necessary.
Provide a clear and unified vision and communicate it to all internal and external stakeholders.
Obtain NCA's approval for any cybersecurity initiatives that are beyond the scope of the organization.
expected_deliverables: Strategy implementation roadmap
List of cybersecurity projects and initiatives and their status
cybersecurity_tools: All cybersecurity strategy models and roadmap
Cybersecurity performance report and measurement template
1-1-2.full_text: 1-1 Cybersecurity Strategy — 1-1-2 A roadmap must be executed to implement the cybersecurity strategy.

1-1-3.title: Periodic Review of Strategy
1-1-3.objective: To ensure the cybersecurity strategy is reviewed periodically or upon material changes.
implementation_guidelines: Review and update the strategy according to a documented and approved review plan.
Review at specific intervals according to best practices.
Review upon changes in relevant laws and regulations or material changes in the organization.
Document and approve the review procedures and changes by the representative.
expected_deliverables: Approved document defining the review schedule
Updated cybersecurity strategy document
Project status reports
Formal approval by the representative on the updated strategy
1-1-3.full_text: 1-1 Cybersecurity Strategy — 1-1-3 The cybersecurity strategy must be reviewed periodically according to planned intervals or upon changes to related laws and regulations.

1-2.title: Cybersecurity Management
1-2.objective: To ensure effective management of cybersecurity programs within the organization as per related laws and regulations.
1-2.full_text: 1-2 Cybersecurity Management: Objective is to ensure effective management of cybersecurity programs within the organization as per related laws and regulations.

1-2-1.title: Establishment of a Dedicated Cybersecurity Function
1-2-1.objective: A dedicated cybersecurity function (e.g., division, department) must be established within the organization.
implementation_guidelines: Establish a cybersecurity function independent from the IT/ICT functions as per Royal Decree number 37140 dated 14/8/1438H.
Ensure the cybersecurity function reports directly to the head of the organization or his/her delegate.
The function is responsible for all cybersecurity monitoring activities (compliance, operation, etc.) and governance activities (requirements, risks, etc.).
expected_deliverables: Organization's organizational structure covering the cybersecurity function
The decision to establish the Cybersecurity functions and its mandate
Reports on the cybersecurity policies compliance results
cybersecurity_tools: Cybersecurity Function Organizational Structure
Cybersecurity Roles and Responsibilities Template
Cybersecurity General Policy Template
1-2-1.full_text: 1-2 Cybersecurity Management — 1-2-1 A dedicated cybersecurity function must be established. This function must be independent from the IT/ICT functions (Royal Decree 37140). It reports directly to the head of the organization.

1-2-2.title: Cybersecurity Human Resources
1-2-2.objective: To fill critical cybersecurity positions with full-time and experienced Saudi cybersecurity professionals.
implementation_guidelines: Appoint full-time and highly qualified Saudi cybersecurity professionals for the Head of cybersecurity (CISO), supervisory positions, and critical roles.
Define required academic qualifications and years of experience relying on The Saudi Cybersecurity Workforce Framework (SCyWF).
Develop job descriptions for the head of cybersecurity and critical positions including minimum experience and professional certificates.
expected_deliverables: Detailed list of all personnel (direct/indirect/contractors) including names, nationality, and qualifications
Job descriptions of the head of cybersecurity and supervisory/critical positions relying on (SCyWF)
1-2-2.full_text: 1-2 Cybersecurity Management — 1-2-2 The position of cybersecurity function head (e.g., CISO), and related supervisory and critical positions, must be filled with full-time and experienced Saudi cybersecurity professionals.

1-2-3.title: Cybersecurity Steering Committee
1-2-3.objective: A cybersecurity steering committee must be established by the Authorizing Official to ensure support and implementation of cybersecurity programs.
implementation_guidelines: Identify committee members including the head of organization or deputy, head of cybersecurity, head of IT, head of Compliance, and head of HR.
Formally document duties and responsibilities in the Committee's Charter approved by the organization's representative.
Conduct periodic meetings to follow up on implementation, manage risks, and ensure alignment with the organization's strategy.
expected_deliverables: Supervisory committee charter in the organization approved by the representative
Documented and approved list of committee members
Cybersecurity supervisory committee's agenda and minutes of meetings
cybersecurity_tools: Cybersecurity supervisory committee governance document template
1-2-3.full_text: 1-2 Cybersecurity Management — 1-2-3 A cybersecurity steering committee must be established to ensure support and implementation of cybersecurity programs. The committee must include the head of the cybersecurity function.

1-3.title: Cybersecurity Policies and Procedures
1-3.objective: To ensure that cybersecurity requirements are documented, communicated and complied with by the organization as per related laws and regulations, and organizational requirements.
1-3.full_text: 1-3 Cybersecurity Policies and Procedures: Objective is to ensure that cybersecurity requirements are documented, communicated and complied with by the organization.

1-3-1.title: Definition and Dissemination of Policies
1-3-1.objective: Cybersecurity policies and procedures must be defined, documented, approved, and disseminated to relevant parties.
implementation_guidelines: Define and document cybersecurity requirements in policies, procedures, and standard controls based on the organization's authority matrix.
Ensure communication of policies through approved channels (e.g., internal portal, e-mail) to internal and external stakeholders.
expected_deliverables: All cybersecurity policies, procedures, and standard controls documented and approved
Evidence of communication to personnel and stakeholders
cybersecurity_tools: All policies, procedures, and standard controls templates included within cybersecurity toolkit
1-3-1.full_text: 1-3 Cybersecurity Policies and Procedures — 1-3-1 Cybersecurity policies and procedures must be defined and documented by the cybersecurity function and disseminated to relevant parties.

1-3-2.title: Implementation of Policies and Procedures
1-3-2.objective: The cybersecurity function must ensure that the cybersecurity policies and procedures are implemented.
implementation_guidelines: Develop an action plan to implement policies and procedures covering all internal and external stakeholders.
Follow-up and monitor periodically to ensure full and effective implementation of all requirements.
Ensure implementation of controls manually or electronically (automated).
expected_deliverables: An action plan to implement the cybersecurity policies and procedures
A report that outlines the review of the implementation of cybersecurity policies and procedures
cybersecurity_tools: A template of personnel acknowledgment and approval to follow the cybersecurity policies
A template of personnel acknowledgment and approval to maintain information confidentiality
1-3-2.full_text: 1-3 Cybersecurity Policies and Procedures — 1-3-2 The cybersecurity function must ensure that the cybersecurity policies and procedures are implemented through an action plan and periodic monitoring.

1-3-3.title: Technical Security Standards
1-3-3.objective: Cybersecurity policies and procedures must be supported by technical security standards.
implementation_guidelines: Define and approve technical standard controls for information and technology assets (e.g., firewalls, networks, databases, operating systems, BYOD, secure development, cryptography).
Communicate technical standards to relevant departments (e.g., IT) and ensure periodic application.
expected_deliverables: The organization's approved technical cybersecurity standard controls documents
cybersecurity_tools: A template of all standard controls included in cybersecurity tools
1-3-3.full_text: 1-3 Cybersecurity Policies and Procedures — 1-3-3 The cybersecurity policies and procedures must be supported by technical security standards (e.g., OS, databases and firewall standards).

1-3-4.title: Review of Policies and Procedures
1-3-4.objective: Cybersecurity policies and procedures must be reviewed periodically or upon changes to related laws and regulations.
implementation_guidelines: Review policies and procedures according to a documented plan and specified intervals (e.g., annually).
Update documents in the event of changes in relevant laws and regulations (e.g., new cybersecurity laws).
Document and approve all changes by the head of the organization or his/her deputy.
expected_deliverables: An approved document that defines the review schedule
An approved document clarifying the periodic review of policies and procedures
Updated policies and procedures indicating review/update history and official approval
1-3-4.full_text: 1-3 Cybersecurity Policies and Procedures — 1-3-4 The cybersecurity policies and procedures must be reviewed periodically according to planned intervals or upon changes to laws. Changes must be approved.

1-4.title: Cybersecurity Roles and Responsibilities
1-4.objective: To ensure that roles and responsibilities are defined for all parties participating in implementing the cybersecurity controls within the organization.
1-4.full_text: 1-4 Cybersecurity Roles and Responsibilities: Objective is to ensure that roles and responsibilities are defined for all parties participating in implementing cybersecurity controls.

1-4-1.title: Definition and Assignment of Roles
1-4-1.objective: Cybersecurity organizational structure and related roles and responsibilities must be defined, documented, approved, and assigned while ensuring no conflict of interest.
implementation_guidelines: Define and document cybersecurity roles and responsibilities and inform all involved parties.
Ensure executive management support through official approval by the representative.

Include roles for: Cybersecurity steering committee, Head of cybersecurity, the Cybersecurity function (policies, risk, compliance, monitoring, etc.), Other departments (IT, HR, Physical Security), and All personnel.
Assign roles to personnel taking into consideration the non-conflict of interests.
expected_deliverables: Cybersecurity Function Organizational Structure Document
The organization's approved cybersecurity roles and responsibilities document
A document that clarifies the assignment of cybersecurity roles and responsibilities to personnel
cybersecurity_tools: Cybersecurity Roles and Responsibilities Template
1-4-1.full_text: 1-4 Cybersecurity Roles and Responsibilities — 1-4-1 Cybersecurity organizational structure and related roles and responsibilities must be defined, documented, and assigned by the Authorizing Official.

1-4-2.title: Review of Roles and Responsibilities
1-4-2.objective: The cybersecurity roles and responsibilities must be reviewed periodically according to planned intervals or upon changes to related laws and regulations.
implementation_guidelines: Review roles and responsibilities periodically based on a documented plan (e.g., annually).
Update roles and responsibilities in the event of changes in relevant laws and regulations.
Document the review and changes and ensure they are approved by the representative.
expected_deliverables: An approved document that defines the review schedule for the roles and responsibilities
Roles and responsibilities document indicating they are up to date with documented and approved changes
1-4-2.full_text: 1-4 Cybersecurity Roles and Responsibilities — 1-4-2 The cybersecurity roles and responsibilities must be reviewed periodically according to planned intervals or upon changes to related laws and regulations.

1-5.title: Cybersecurity Risk Management
1-5.objective: To ensure managing cybersecurity risks in a methodological approach in order to protect the organization's assets and comply with policies, procedures, and related laws and regulations.
1-5.full_text: 1-5 Cybersecurity Risk Management: Objective is to ensure managing cybersecurity risks in a methodological approach to protect assets and ensure compliance.

1-5-1.title: Establishment of Risk Management Methodology
1-5-1.objective: Cybersecurity risk management methodology and procedures must be defined, documented and approved based on CIA considerations.
implementation_guidelines: Define and document risk management requirements based on regulations and best practices.

The methodology must include: Asset identification and valuation, Identification of risks, Risk assessment (likelihood and impact), Risk response (treatment methods), and Risk monitoring (updating the register).
Ensure executive management support through official approval by the representative.
expected_deliverables: The approved cybersecurity risk management methodology document
Approved cybersecurity risk management procedures
cybersecurity_tools: Cybersecurity Risk Management Policy Template
Cybersecurity Risk Management Procedures Template
1-5-1.full_text: 1-5 Cybersecurity Risk Management — 1-5-1 Methodology and procedures for risk management must be defined, documented, and approved considering Confidentiality, Integrity, and Availability (CIA).

1-5-2.title: Implementation of Risk Management
1-5-2.objective: The cybersecurity risk management methodology and procedures must be implemented by the cybersecurity function.
implementation_guidelines: Implement all requirements of the adopted risk management methodology.
Establish a cybersecurity risk register to document and monitor risks.
Develop plans to address and treat cybersecurity risks.
expected_deliverables: Cybersecurity Risk Register of the organization
Cybersecurity Risk Treatment Plan
A report outlining cybersecurity risk assessment and monitoring
cybersecurity_tools: Cybersecurity Risk Management Register Template
1-5-2.full_text: 1-5 Cybersecurity Risk Management — 1-5-2 Implementation of risk management requirements, including the establishment of a risk register and treatment plans.

1-5-3.title: Specific Cases for Risk Assessment
1-5-3.objective: Implementation of risk assessment procedures in specific critical scenarios.
implementation_guidelines: Risk assessments must be integrated into technology projects, infrastructure changes, third-party planning, and new product releases.
expected_deliverables: Risk assessment reports for all specified scenarios
1-5-3.full_text: 1-5 Cybersecurity Risk Management — 1-5-3 Risk assessment procedures must be implemented in early stages of projects, before major changes, during third-party planning, and before going live.

1-5-3-1.title: Early Stages of Technology Projects
1-5-3-1.objective: Implement risk assessment during the first phase of the information and technology projects lifecycle.
implementation_guidelines: Include cybersecurity requirements within the Technical Project Lifecycle.
Assess risks early to identify asset exposure, potential threats, and vulnerabilities.
Remediate all risks in accordance with the approved methodology.
expected_deliverables: Report outlining identification, assessment, and remediation of risks throughout the project lifecycle
1-5-3-1.full_text: 1-5 Cybersecurity Risk Management — 1-5-3-1 Implementation of cybersecurity risk assessment in the early stages of technical projects.

1-5-3-2.title: Major Changes to Technology Infrastructure
1-5-3-2.objective: Implement risk assessment before making material changes to the technology architecture.
implementation_guidelines: Include requirements within the IT Change Management lifecycle.
Perform assessment before updates to database systems or radical changes in network mapping.
Remediate identified risks before finalizing changes.
expected_deliverables: Report on risk assessment and remediation for material changes to the production environment
1-5-3-2.full_text: 1-5 Cybersecurity Risk Management — 1-5-3-2 Risk assessment must be performed before major changes like network re-mapping or database updates.

1-5-3-3.title: Planning Third-Party Services
1-5-3-3.objective: Implement risk assessment during the planning phase of obtaining third-party services.
implementation_guidelines: Integrate requirements into third-party, contracts, and procurement management procedures.
Identify risks related to outsourcing IT or managed services.
Remediate risks as per the approved methodology.
expected_deliverables: Report outlining identification, assessment, and remediation of third-party cybersecurity risks
1-5-3-3.full_text: 1-5 Cybersecurity Risk Management — 1-5-3-3 Risk assessment for third-party services, including outsourcing and managed services.

1-5-3-4.title: New Technology Services and Products
1-5-3-4.objective: Risk assessment before going live for new services and products.
implementation_guidelines: Include requirements within the Release Management procedures.
Assess risks during planning and before the release of new products to the production environment.
Identify potential threat exposure and vulnerabilities for new releases.
expected_deliverables: Report on risk assessment and remediation before releasing new technical products to production
1-5-3-4.full_text: 1-5 Cybersecurity Risk Management — 1-5-3-4 Risk assessment during planning and before going live for new technology services.

1-5-4.title: Periodic Review of Risk Management
1-5-4.objective: Review risk management methodology and procedures periodically or upon regulatory changes.
implementation_guidelines: Review and update the methodology and procedures based on a documented plan (e.g., annually).
Update in the event of new cybersecurity laws or regulations.
Document and approve all changes by the representative.
expected_deliverables: Approved review schedule for risk management methodology
Updated methodology and procedures indicating review and official approval
1-5-4.full_text: 1-5 Cybersecurity Risk Management — 1-5-4 Periodic review of risk management methodology and procedures to ensure alignment with laws and organizational needs.

1-6.title: Cybersecurity in Information and Technology Project Management
1-6.objective: To ensure that cybersecurity requirements are included in project management methodology and procedures in order to protect the confidentiality, integrity and availability of information and technology assets as per organization policies and procedures, and related laws and regulations.
1-6.full_text: To ensure that cybersecurity requirements are included in project management methodology and procedures in order to protect the confidentiality, integrity and availability of information and technology assets as per organization policies and procedures, and related laws and regulations.

1-6-1.title: Inclusion of Cybersecurity Requirements in Project and Asset Change Management
1-6-1.objective: Cybersecurity requirements must be included in project and asset (information/ technology) change management methodology and procedures to identify and manage cybersecurity risks as part of project management lifecycle. The cybersecurity requirements must be a key part of the overall requirements of technology projects.
implementation_guidelines: Include cybersecurity requirements in the project management methodology and procedures and in the change management of the information and technology assets in the organization to ensure that cybersecurity risks are identified and addressed. Such requirements include:
Assess and detect vulnerabilities before the deployment of services or systems online, or upon any change to systems within Information and Technology Project Management.
Fix identified vulnerabilities before launching projects and changes.
Review Secure Configuration and Hardening and Patching and address observations identified before launching projects and changes.
Define the requirements for connection with cyber surveillance systems.
Support cybersecurity requirements of the project management methodology and procedures by the Executive Management through the approval of the head of the organization or his/her deputy.
expected_deliverables: Project Management Methodology Document in the organization.
Change management methodology or procedures in the organization's information and technology assets document.
cybersecurity_tools: Secure Software Development Cycle Policy Template
Secure Software Development Cycle Procedure Template
1-6-1.full_text: Cybersecurity requirements must be included in project and asset (information/ technology) change management methodology and procedures to identify and manage cybersecurity risks as part of project management lifecycle. The cybersecurity requirements must be a key part of the overall requirements of technology projects.

1-6-2.title: Cybersecurity Requirements in Project and Assets Change Management
1-6-2.objective: The cybersecurity requirements in project and assets (information/technology) change management must include at least the following: 1-6-2-1 Vulnerability assessment and remediation. 1-6-2-2 Conducting a configurations' review, secure configuration and hardening and patching before changes or going live for technology projects.
1-6-2.full_text: The cybersecurity requirements in project and assets (information/technology) change management must include at least the following: 1-6-2-1 Vulnerability assessment and remediation. 1-6-2-2 Conducting a configurations' review, secure configuration and hardening and patching before changes or going live for technology projects.

1-6-2-1.title: Vulnerability Assessment and Remediation
implementation_guidelines: Define and document the requirements of this control in the cybersecurity requirements document and approve them by the representative.
Define systems, services, and technology components subject to Vulnerabilities Assessment within the scope of technical projects and change requests.
Develop and adopt procedures for the implementation of Vulnerabilities Assessment and remediation in accordance with related laws and regulations.
Conduct Vulnerabilities Assessment before launching technical projects in the production environment and assess it in a timely manner and address it effectively.
Conduct Vulnerabilities Assessment before the implementation of changes to the production environment and assess it in a timely manner and address it effectively.
expected_deliverables: A document (such as approved policy or procedure) indicating the identification and documentation of the requirements related to this control.
A report that outlines the assessment and remediation of cybersecurity vulnerabilities throughout the technical project lifecycle and changes to information and technology assets.
cybersecurity_tools: Cybersecurity Requirements Checklist Template for Project Management and Changes to Information and Technology Assets

1-6-2-2.title: Secure Configuration, Hardening and Patching Review
1-6-2-2.objective: 1-6-2-2 Conducting a configurations' review, secure configuration and hardening and patching before changes or going live for technology projects.
implementation_guidelines: Define and document the requirements of this ECC in the cybersecurity requirements document and approve them by the representative.
Define systems, services, and technology components subject to Secure Configuration and Hardening review within the scope of technical projects and change requests.
Provide technical Security Standard controls for systems, services, and technology components subject to Secure Configuration and Hardening review.
Develop and adopt procedures for the implementation of Secure Configuration and Hardening review in accordance with the relevant laws and regulations.
Review secure Configuration and Hardening and Patching before launching technology projects in the production environment.
Review secure Configuration and Hardening and Patching before implementing changes to the production environment.
expected_deliverables: A document (such as approved policy or procedure) indicating the identification and documentation of the requirements related to this control.
Technical Security Standard controls for systems, services, and technology components subject to Secure Configuration and Hardening review.

A report that outlines the assessment and review of Secure Configuration and Hardening throughout the technical project lifecycle and changes to information and technology assets in the organization before launching projects and implementing changes.
cybersecurity_tools: Cybersecurity Requirements Checklist Template for Application Development
1-6-2-2.full_text: 1-6-2-2 Conducting a configurations' review, secure configuration and hardening and patching before changes or going live for technology projects.

1-6-3.title: Cybersecurity Requirements Related to Software and Application Development Projects
1-6-3.objective: The cybersecurity requirements related to software and application development projects must include at least the following: 1-6-3-1 Using secure coding standards. 1-6-3-2 Using trusted and licensed sources for software development tools and libraries. 1-6-3-3 Conducting compliance test for software against the defined organizational cybersecurity requirements. 1-6-3-4 Secure integration between software components. 1-6-3-5 Conducting a configurations review, secure configuration and hardening and patching before going live for software products.
1-6-3.full_text: The cybersecurity requirements related to software and application development projects must include at least the following: 1-6-3-1 Using secure coding standards. 1-6-3-2 Using trusted and licensed sources for software development tools and libraries. 1-6-3-3 Conducting compliance test for software against the defined organizational cybersecurity requirements. 1-6-3-4 Secure integration between software components. 1-6-3-5 Conducting a configurations review, secure configuration and hardening and patching before going live for software products.

1-6-3-1.title: Using Secure Coding Standards
implementation_guidelines: Define and document the requirements of this ECC in the cybersecurity requirements document and approve them by the representative.

Define and document technical cybersecurity requirements for Secure Coding Standard controls (covering all phases of the secure coding process) based on relevant laws and regulations, best practices and standard controls related to the development and protection of software and applications against internal and external threats in the organization to minimize cyber risks and focus on key security objectives namely; confidentiality, integrity, and availability.
Communicate Secure Coding Standard controls to the relevant departments in the organization (e.g., IT department) and their implementation periodically.
expected_deliverables: A document (such as approved policy or procedure) indicating the identification and documentation of the requirements related to this control.
Secure Coding Standard controls approved by the organization.
Documents that confirm the implementation of Secure Coding Standard controls to information and technology assets.
cybersecurity_tools: Secure Coding Standard Template

1-6-3-2.title: Trusted and Licensed Sources for Software Tools and Libraries
1-6-3-2.objective: 1-6-3-2 Using trusted and licensed sources for software development tools and libraries.
implementation_guidelines: Define and document the requirements of this ECC in the cybersecurity requirements document and approve them by the representative.
Use only modern, reliable and licensed sources for software development tools and libraries.
expected_deliverables: A document (such as approved policy or procedure) indicating the identification and documentation of the requirements related to this control.
An updated list of licensed and documented software used for application development tools and libraries.
1-6-3-2.full_text: 1-6-3-2 Using trusted and licensed sources for software development tools and libraries.

1-6-3-3.title: Compliance Test for Software Against Defined Requirements
1-6-3-3.objective: 1-6-3-3 Conducting compliance test for software against the defined organizational cybersecurity requirements.
implementation_guidelines: Define and document the requirements of this ECC in the cybersecurity requirements document and approve them by the representative.

Conduct testing to verify that applications meet the cybersecurity requirements of the organizations, such as penetration testing, to ensure that cybersecurity controls are applied to the development of secure coding standard controls and detect weaknesses, vulnerabilities, and issues in software.
Access Management requirements for users and review the cybersecurity architecture.
expected_deliverables: A document (such as approved policy or procedure) indicating the identification and documentation of the requirements related to this control.

List of application development projects and list of security tests performed to verify the comprehensiveness of the tests and the extent to which the applications meet the organization's cybersecurity requirements and implementation reports.
cybersecurity_tools: Cybersecurity Requirements Checklist Template for Application Development
1-6-3-3.full_text: 1-6-3-3 Conducting compliance test for software against the defined organizational cybersecurity requirements.

1-6-3-4.title: Secure Integration Between Software Components
implementation_guidelines: Define and document the requirements of this ECC in the cybersecurity requirements document and approve them by the representative.
Ensure security of integration between applications by, but not limited to, security testing of various integration technologies, including:
Perform System Integration Testing (SIT).
Perform API testing.
expected_deliverables: A document (such as approved policy or procedure) indicating the identification and documentation of the requirements related to this control.
A report that outlines the testing and assessment of secure Integration between applications based on the organization's cybersecurity requirements and implementation reports.

1-6-3-5.title: Review Before Going Live for Software Products
1-6-3-5.objective: 1-6-3-5 Conducting a configurations review, secure configuration and hardening and patching before going live for software products.
implementation_guidelines: Define and document the requirements of this ECC in the cybersecurity requirements document and approve them by the representative.
Review secure Configuration and Hardening and Patching before launching applications and ensure their implementation in the following cases:

Secure Configuration and Hardening of information and technology assets and applications must be reviewed periodically and their implementation according to the approved technical security standard controls must be ensured.
Secure configuration and hardening must be reviewed before launching projects and changes in information and technology assets.
Secure Configuration and Hardening must be reviewed before launching applications.
Approve the Image for the Secure configuration and hardening of information and technology assets in accordance with the technical security standard controls and kept it in a safe place.

Provide technology required to centrally manage Secure Configuration and Hardening and ensure the automated implementation or update of Secure Configuration and Hardening for all information and technology assets at pre-determined regular intervals.
expected_deliverables: A document (such as approved policy or procedure) indicating the identification and documentation of the requirements related to this control.
Reports or evidence that Secure Configuration and Hardening and patching are reviewed before launching applications.
Reports or evidence that Secure Configuration and Hardening and patching are periodically reviewed.
1-6-3-5.full_text: 1-6-3-5 Conducting a configurations review, secure configuration and hardening and patching before going live for software products.

1-6-4.title: Periodic Review of Project Management Requirements
1-6-4.objective: The cybersecurity requirements in project management must be reviewed periodically.
implementation_guidelines: Review the cybersecurity project management requirements periodically according to a documented and approved plan for review and based on a planned interval (e.g., periodic review must be conducted annually).
Document the review and changes to the cybersecurity requirements for project management in the organization and approve them by the head of the organization or his/her deputy.
expected_deliverables: An approved document that defines the review schedule for the cybersecurity requirements for project management.
Evidence that the periodic review of cybersecurity requirements in project management and changes to the information and technology assets of the organization is performed.
1-6-4.full_text: The cybersecurity requirements in project management must be reviewed periodically.

1-7.title: Compliance with Cybersecurity Standard controls, Laws and Regulations
1-7.objective: To ensure that the organization's cybersecurity program is in compliance with related laws and regulations.
1-7.full_text: To ensure that the organization's cybersecurity program is in compliance with related laws and regulations.

1-7-1.title: Compliance with National Cybersecurity Laws and Regulations
1-7-1.objective: The organization must comply with related national cybersecurity laws and regulations.
implementation_guidelines: Work with stakeholders in the organization (i.e., legal function and governance and compliance function) to identify, document, and periodically update a list of national cybersecurity laws and regulations and related requirements that are relevant to the organization's operations and issued by the National Cybersecurity Authority (NCA) (which might include, but not limited to, royal orders and decrees, orders issued by the Council of Ministers, and official circulars and regulatory orders issued by the National Cybersecurity Authority (NCA)).
Ensure compliance with all national cybersecurity laws and regulations requirements referred to in the previous point.
Provide necessary technologies; to verify compliance with national cybersecurity laws and regulations.
Prepare periodic reports for organization's compliance with all national cybersecurity laws and regulations to be submitted to the National Cybersecurity Authority (NCA) whenever requested.
expected_deliverables: A document (such as a policy, procedure, or/and letter approved by the authorization official) indicating the identification and documentation of the requirements related to this control.
An updated list that clarifies the national cybersecurity laws and regulations that are relevant to the organization's operations and issued by the National Cybersecurity Authority (NCA).
A report that clarifies the extent of organization's compliance with national cybersecurity laws and regulations applicable to the organization.
cybersecurity_tools: Compliance with Cybersecurity Standard controls, Laws and Regulations Policy Template
1-7-1.full_text: The organization must comply with related national cybersecurity laws and regulations.

1-7-2.title: Compliance with International Cybersecurity Agreements and Commitments
1-7-2.objective: The organization must comply with any nationally-approved international agreements and commitments related to cybersecurity.
implementation_guidelines: Work with the organization's stakeholders to identify, document, approve and periodically update the list of international cybersecurity agreements or obligations, and periodically document and update them, subject to prior approval by the National Cybersecurity Authority.
Ensure compliance with all cybersecurity national laws and regulations requirements approved by the National Cybersecurity Authority within the organization.
Provide necessary technologies to verify compliance with the laws and regulations related to cybersecurity.
expected_deliverables: A document (such as approved policy or procedure) indicating the identification and documentation of the requirements related to this control.
An updated list of locally approved international agreements and obligations applicable to cybersecurity function.
A report that outlines the extent of compliance with cybersecurity international agreements and obligations applicable to the organization.
1-7-2.full_text: The organization must comply with any nationally-approved international agreements and commitments related to cybersecurity.

1-8.title: Periodical Cybersecurity Review and Audit
1-8.objective: To ensure that cybersecurity controls are implemented and in compliance with organizational policies and procedures, as well as related national and international laws, regulations and agreements.[cite: 2]
1-8.full_text: To ensure that cybersecurity controls are implemented and in compliance with organizational policies and procedures, as well as related national and international laws, regulations and agreements.[cite: 2]

1-8-1.title: Internal Cybersecurity Reviews
1-8-1.objective: Cybersecurity reviews must be conducted periodically by the cybersecurity function in the organization to assess the compliance with the cybersecurity controls in the organization.[cite: 2]
implementation_guidelines: Review the implementation of cybersecurity requirements at the organization by the cybersecurity function periodically according to a documented and approved plan for review and based on a period specified in the policy (e.g., quarterly review), to ensure that the cybersecurity controls of the organization are effectively implemented and operate in accordance with the regulatory policies and procedures of the organization, the national laws and regulations, and the international requirements approved by the organization.[cite: 2]
expected_deliverables: A document (such as approved policy or procedure) indicating the identification and documentation of the requirements related to this control.[cite: 2]
Approved plan to review the implementation of cybersecurity controls.[cite: 2]
Documents that confirm the implementation of Cybersecurity Standard controls to information, technology, and physical assets.[cite: 2]
Periodic review reports of cybersecurity controls implementation in the organization.[cite: 2]
cybersecurity_tools: Cybersecurity Review and Audit Template[cite: 2]
Cybersecurity Review and Audit Log Template[cite: 2]
1-8-1.full_text: Cybersecurity reviews must be conducted periodically by the cybersecurity function in the organization to assess the compliance with the cybersecurity controls in the organization.[cite: 2]

1-8-2.title: Independent Cybersecurity Audits
1-8-2.objective: Cybersecurity audits and reviews must be conducted by independent parties outside the cybersecurity function (e.g., Internal Audit function) to assess the compliance with the cybersecurity controls in the organization. Audits and reviews must be conducted independently, while ensuring that this does not result in a conflict of interest, as per the Generally Accepted Auditing Standard controls (GAAS), and related laws and regulations.[cite: 2]
implementation_guidelines: Review and audit cybersecurity controls implementation at the organization by parties independent of the cybersecurity function, such as the internal audit department, or by third parties that cooperated with independently from the relevant cybersecurity function to achieve the principle of non-conflict of interests when reviewing the implementation of all cybersecurity requirements in the organization.[cite: 2]

Perform the review periodically according to a documented and approved plan for review and based on a period specified in the policy (e.g., review must be conducted annually), in order to ensure that the organization's cybersecurity controls are effectively implemented and operate in accordance with the regulatory policies and procedures of the organization, the national laws and regulations approved by NCA, and the international requirements approved by the organization.[cite: 2]
expected_deliverables: A document (such as approved policy or procedure) indicating the identification and documentation of the requirements related to this control.[cite: 2]
Approved plan to review and audit the implementation of cybersecurity controls.[cite: 2]
Audit reports (by the internal audit department or an independent external auditor) on all cybersecurity requirements of the organization.[cite: 2]
cybersecurity_tools: Cybersecurity Review and Audit Template[cite: 2]
Cybersecurity Review and Audit Log Template[cite: 2]
1-8-2.full_text: Cybersecurity audits and reviews must be conducted by independent parties outside the cybersecurity function (e.g., Internal Audit function) to assess the compliance with the cybersecurity controls in the organization. Audits and reviews must be conducted independently, while ensuring that this does not result in a conflict of interest, as per the Generally Accepted Auditing Standard controls (GAAS), and related laws and regulations.[cite: 2]

1-8-3.title: Reporting Audit and Review Results
1-8-3.objective: Results from the cybersecurity audits and reviews must be documented and presented to the cybersecurity steering committee and Authorizing Official. Results must include the audit/review scope, observations, recommendations and remediation plans.[cite: 2]
implementation_guidelines: Review and document results of cybersecurity review and audit.[cite: 2]
The review report must include: Scope of review and audit, Discovered observations, Recommendations and corrective actions, and Observations remediation plan.[cite: 2]
Share and discuss the results of cybersecurity review and audit with the cybersecurity supervisory committee and the representative.[cite: 2]
expected_deliverables: A document (such as approved policy or procedure) indicating the identification and documentation of the requirements related to this control.[cite: 2]
Audit reports (by the internal audit department or compliance department or an independent external auditor) on all cybersecurity requirements of the organization.[cite: 2]
Evidence that the results of the cybersecurity review and audit presented to the cybersecurity supervisory committee and the representative.[cite: 2]
cybersecurity_tools: Cybersecurity Review Report Template[cite: 2]
1-8-3.full_text: Results from the cybersecurity audits and reviews must be documented and presented to the cybersecurity steering committee and Authorizing Official. Results must include the audit/review scope, observations, recommendations and remediation plans.[cite: 2]

1-9.title: Cybersecurity in Human Resources
1-9.objective: To ensure that cybersecurity risks and requirements related to personnel (employees and contractors) are managed efficiently prior to employment, during employment and after termination/separation as per organizational policies and procedures, and related laws and regulations.[cite: 1]
1-9.full_text: To ensure that cybersecurity risks and requirements related to personnel (employees and contractors) are managed efficiently prior to employment, during employment and after termination/separation as per organizational policies and procedures, and related laws and regulations.[cite: 1]

1-9-1.title: Personnel Cybersecurity Requirements Definition
1-9-1.objective: Personnel cybersecurity requirements (prior to employment, during employment and after termination/separation) must be defined, documented and approved.[cite: 1]
implementation_guidelines: Define and document personnel cybersecurity requirements in the cybersecurity requirements document and approved by the representative.[cite: 1]

Requirements include, but are not limited to: Include cybersecurity responsibilities and non-disclosure clauses in the contracts of employees in the organization (to cover the periods during and after the end/termination of the job relationship with the organization).[cite: 1]
Conduct screening or vetting for the personnel of cybersecurity functions, technical functions with privileged access, and critical systems functions.[cite: 1]

Ensure the comprehensiveness of the cybersecurity requirements related to employees during the employee's lifecycle in the organization, including the following requirements: Cybersecurity requirements prior to recruitment, Cybersecurity requirements during work, and Cybersecurity requirements upon completion or termination of work.[cite: 1]
Support the organization's policy by the Executive Management This must be done through the approval of the organization head or his/her deputy.[cite: 1]
expected_deliverables: Cybersecurity policy for human resources approved by the representative.[cite: 1]
cybersecurity_tools: Human Resources Cybersecurity Policy Template[cite: 1]
1-9-1.full_text: Personnel cybersecurity requirements (prior to employment, during employment and after termination/separation) must be defined, documented and approved.[cite: 1]

1-9-2.title: Implementation of Personnel Cybersecurity Requirements
1-9-2.objective: The personnel cybersecurity requirements must be implemented.[cite: 1]
implementation_guidelines: Implement all personnel-related cybersecurity requirements that have been identified, documented and approved in the Human Resources Cybersecurity Policy.[cite: 1]
Develop an action plan to implement cybersecurity requirements related to the personnel of the organization.[cite: 1]
Include personnel cybersecurity requirements in the organization's HR procedures to ensure compliance with cybersecurity requirements for all internal and external stakeholders.[cite: 1]
expected_deliverables: Documents that confirm the implementation of cybersecurity requirements related to personnel as documented in the HR Cybersecurity Policy.[cite: 1]
Cybersecurity Function Personnel Contract Forms (signed copy).[cite: 1]
Screening or vetting requests for the personnel of cybersecurity functions and technical functions with privileged access.[cite: 1]

1-9-4.title: Cybersecurity Requirements During Employment

1-9-5.title: Termination or Separation Requirements
1-9-5.objective: Personnel access to information and technology assets must be reviewed and removed immediately upon termination/separation.[cite: 1]
implementation_guidelines: Define and document the requirements of this ECC in the cybersecurity requirements document and approve them by the representative.[cite: 1]

Define professional end-of-service or termination procedures covering cybersecurity requirements.[cite: 1]

expected_deliverables: A discharge form with a signed and approved sample for the implementation of the procedures.[cite: 1]

1-9-6.title: Periodic Review of Personnel Cybersecurity Requirements
1-9-6.objective: Personnel cybersecurity requirements must be reviewed periodically.[cite: 1]
implementation_guidelines: Review and update the cybersecurity policy and requirements for personnel in the organization periodically according to a documented and approved plan for review and based on a planned interval (e.g., review must be conducted annually) or in the event of changes in related laws and regulations.[cite: 1]
Document the review and changes to the cybersecurity requirements for personnel in the organization and approve them by the head of the organization or his/her deputy.[cite: 1]
expected_deliverables: An approved document that sets the policy's review schedule.[cite: 1]

1-9-6.full_text: Personnel cybersecurity requirements must be reviewed periodically.[cite: 1]

1-10.title: Cybersecurity Awareness and Training Program
1-10.objective: To ensure that personnel are aware of their cybersecurity responsibilities and have the essential cybersecurity awareness. It is also to ensure that personnel are provided with the required cybersecurity training, skills and credentials needed to accomplish their cybersecurity responsibilities and to protect the organization's information and technology assets.[cite: 1]
1-10.full_text: To ensure that personnel are aware of their cybersecurity responsibilities and have the essential cybersecurity awareness. It is also to ensure that personnel are provided with the required cybersecurity training, skills and credentials needed to accomplish their cybersecurity responsibilities and to protect the organization's information and technology assets.[cite: 1]

1-10-1.title: Cybersecurity Awareness Program Development
1-10-1.objective: A cybersecurity awareness program must be developed and approved. The program must be conducted periodically through multiple channels to strengthen the awareness about cybersecurity, cyber threats and risks, and to build a positive cybersecurity awareness culture.[cite: 1]
implementation_guidelines: Develop and approve cybersecurity awareness program and plan in the organization through multiple channels periodically, including but not limited to: Awareness emails, Cybersecurity awareness workshops, Distribution of awareness publications, Awareness presentation through billboards, and Launch of a cybersecurity training and awareness platform.[cite: 1]

The program may include a plan to coordinate with the Human Resources department, the Media and Internal Communications department, and the cybersecurity function to raise awareness of cybersecurity, its threats and risks, and build a positive cybersecurity culture.[cite: 1]
The organization's program must be supported by the Executive Management. This must be done through the approval of the representative.[cite: 1]
expected_deliverables: The awareness program document approved by the organization.[cite: 1]
cybersecurity_tools: Awareness program template.[cite: 1]
Awareness content template for all employees.[cite: 1]
Awareness content form for supervisory and executive positions.[cite: 1]
Information and Technology Assets Operators Awareness Content Form.[cite: 1]
1-10-1.full_text: A cybersecurity awareness program must be developed and approved. The program must be conducted periodically through multiple channels to strengthen the awareness about cybersecurity, cyber threats and risks, and to build a positive cybersecurity awareness culture.[cite: 1]

Evaluate cybersecurity awareness of all personnel and define and address cybersecurity weaknesses.[cite: 1]
expected_deliverables: Action plan to implement the cybersecurity awareness program adopted by the organization.[cite: 1]
Awareness programs to be shared with employees.[cite: 1]
List of beneficiaries of awareness programs.[cite: 1]
1-10-2.full_text: The cybersecurity awareness program must be implemented.[cite: 1]
